docs.text: Welcome to LearnPDXSL Goal This is LearnD3D11, a guide aimed at anyone trying to learn the Paradox Shading Language used in games such as HOI4. This guide explains the basic usage of PDXSL and shader programming, without requiring any previous experience with shaders. Disclaimer I'm just a college student and I do this in my free time. This project is also still a work in progress; so some content may be missing or faulty. If you find typos, bugs or have questions, please open an issue or PR. Getting started To get started reading LearnPDXSL, you can jump right into the first chapter !
